# One name, one meaning at file scope.

# Unexported members are private to their declaring package. Only the type name
# is gated on import, so without this its unexported members came along.
! sngl check private_field.sngl
stderr '_hidden is unexported'

! sngl check private_method.sngl
stderr '_secret is unexported'

# Exported members through the same import are fine, and a package reaches its
# own unexported members.
sngl check exported_ok.sngl
stdout 'exported_ok.sngl: ok'

sngl check own_package.sngl
stdout 'own_package.sngl: ok'

# Two declarations of one name.
! sngl check redeclared.sngl
stderr 'redeclared in this file'

# Two imports claiming one alias.
! sngl check dup_alias.sngl
stderr 'already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# A declaration may not take a name an import alias already binds — every
# qualified reference through that alias would break.
! sngl check decl_vs_alias.sngl
stderr 'already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# A declaration may shadow a dot-imported name: only one of the two is written
# here, so there is no ambiguity. This is the stdlib override story.
sngl check shadows_dot.sngl
stdout 'shadows_dot.sngl: ok'

# A dot import may shadow a built-in for the same reason.
sngl check shadows_builtin.sngl
stdout 'shadows_builtin.sngl: ok'

# All three built-in resolution paths, because they are three different paths:
# a struct built-in resolves through scope, a scalar is matched in the registry
# before scope is consulted, and a generic is constructed from its mark. If any
# of them ignored the lift, adding a built-in would break every package that
# already exported that name.
sngl check shadows_builtin_scalar.sngl
stdout 'shadows_builtin_scalar.sngl: ok'

sngl check shadows_builtin_generic.sngl
stdout 'shadows_builtin_generic.sngl: ok'


# The one-name rule reaches free functions, consts and vars, not just types and
# components. These live in the package's root symbol table rather than its
# type or component maps, and lifting them unclaimed made which package a bare
# name referred to depend on the order the imports were written in.
! sngl check dup_dot_func.sngl
stderr 'lifts "Greet", already lifted by dot import of'

! sngl check dup_dot_const.sngl
stderr 'lifts "LIMIT", already lifted by dot import of'

# Duplicate bindings that used to be silently last-wins.
! sngl check dup_const.sngl
stderr '"K" redeclared in this file'

! sngl check dup_component_var.sngl
stderr 'y is already declared in this scope'

! sngl check dup_loop_var.sngl
stderr 'k is already declared in this scope'

# Two bindings of one package is a restated name, not an ambiguous one: both
# denote the same package. Two packages claiming one name still collide.
sngl check restate_import.sngl
stdout 'restate_import.sngl: ok'

! sngl check ambiguous_alias.sngl
stderr 'already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# Visibility is enforced where a member is resolved by name, not at each access
# site: a struct literal, an enum member reached either way, and a call through
# a func-typed field all name a member and all used to reach a private one.
! sngl check private_literal.sngl
stderr 'Box._hidden is unexported'

! sngl check private_enum_member.sngl
stderr 'Mode._B is unexported'

! sngl check private_enum_bare.sngl
stderr 'Mode._B is unexported'

! sngl check private_field_call.sngl
stderr 'Box._run is unexported'

# An unknown exported field still reports as unknown rather than as private.
! sngl check unknown_field.sngl
stderr 'unknown field "nope" on struct Box'

# The declaring package reaches its own private members by every one of those
# paths.
sngl check private_same_package.sngl
stdout 'private_same_package.sngl: ok'

# true, false and null are declarations in sngl:builtin, not names the parser
# knows, so a declaration of your own shadows them like any other name. While
# the parser recognised them they could not be shadowed at all.
sngl check shadows_true.sngl
stdout 'shadows_true.sngl: ok'

sngl check shadows_null.sngl
stdout 'shadows_null.sngl: ok'

# PLATFORM is supplied by the compiler off its #[builtin] mark, so a constant
# of your own by that name is an ordinary constant and wins.
sngl generate --out platout shadow_platform.sngl
grep 'SHADOWED' platout/index.html
! grep 'TARGET' platout/index.html

-- w/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Box {
    v int = 0
    _hidden int = 0
}

func Box._secret() => 42

func Box.Shown() => 1
-- other/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Box {
    other int = 0
}
-- mycolor/lib.sngl --
struct color {
    tag string = "mine"
}
-- private_field.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b._hidden

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- private_method.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b._secret()

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- exported_ok.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import w "w"

func f(b w.Box) => b.Shown()

func g(b w.Box) => b.v

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- own_package.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Local {
    _p int = 0
}

func Local._m() => 1

func use(l Local) => l._m() + l._p

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- redeclared.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func dup() => 1

func dup() => 2

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_alias.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import x "w"
import x "other"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- decl_vs_alias.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import helper "w"

component helper() {
    text(value="x")
}

component main {
    text(value="y")
}
-- shadows_dot.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component text(value string) {
    button(text=value)
}

component main {
    text(value="mine")
}
-- shadows_builtin.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "mycolor"

func f() => color{tag="x"}.tag

component main {
    text(value=f())
}
-- shadowers/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct int {
    n string = ""
}

enum option { first, second }
-- shadows_builtin_scalar.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "shadowers"

func f() => int{n = "mine"}.n

component main {
    text(value=f())
}
-- shadows_builtin_generic.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "shadowers"

var picked option = first

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- pa/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func Greet() => "from A"
-- pb/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func Greet() => "from B"
-- pc/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const LIMIT = 1
-- pd/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const LIMIT = 2
-- dup_dot_func.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "pa"
import . "pb"

component main {
    text(value=Greet())
}
-- dup_dot_const.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "pc"
import . "pd"

component main {
    text(value="{LIMIT}")
}
-- dup_const.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const K = 1
const K = 2

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_component_var.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    var y int = 1
    var y int = 2
    text(value="x")
}
-- dup_loop_var.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    var m map<string, string> = {}
    for k, k = m {
        text(value=k)
    }
}
-- restate_import.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:ui/draw"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}

-- ambiguous_alias.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import x "sngl:ui/draw"
import x "sngl:i18n"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}

-- boxes/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Box {
    v int
    _hidden int
    _run func() int
}

enum Mode { A, _B }
-- private_literal.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import b "boxes"

func f() => b.Box{v = 1, _hidden = 2}.v
-- private_enum_member.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import b "boxes"

func f() => b.Mode._B
-- private_enum_bare.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import b "boxes"

var m b.Mode = _B
-- private_field_call.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import b "boxes"

func f(x b.Box) => x._run()
-- unknown_field.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import b "boxes"

func f() => b.Box{nope = 1}.v
-- private_same_package.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Box {
    v int
    _hidden int
}

enum Mode { A, _B }

func f() => Box{v = 1, _hidden = 2}._hidden

func g() => Mode._B

var m Mode = _B

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- shadows_true.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const true = 0 != 0

component main {
    text(value="{true}")
}
-- shadows_null.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const null = "nothing"

component main {
    text(value=null)
}
-- shadow_platform.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

output { none { html } }

const PLATFORM = "zzz"

component main {
    window #w(href="/index.html") {
        if PLATFORM == "html" {
            text(value="TARGET")
        }
        if PLATFORM == "zzz" {
            text(value="SHADOWED")
        }
    }
}
